race.title: All-Weather Championships Season XIV Fleur De Lys Fillies' Stakes (Listed)
race.verdict: Last year's heroine SKY SAFARI enhanced her fine record on speed-favouring all-weather tracks when landing the Winter Derby here back in February. Lightly raced and better than form figures would suggest thereafter, this has likely been her target again and James Fanshawe's mare rates a big player again. Kon Tiki (2-2 on all-weather) will find this more suitable than her Group 1 assignment latest and is feared, with improving 3-y-o Enchanted Queen also making the shortlist up in class. SKY SAFARI KON TIKI ENCHANTED QUEEN
race.bettingForecast: Kon Tiki (3/1), Sky Safari (7/2), Enchanted Queen (6/1), American Gal (6/1), Pacific Mission (13/2), Arisaig (12/1), Nandita (20/1), Aviatrice (20/1), Queen's Reign (20/1), Song N Dance (20/1), Domina Ignis (20/1), All Moonshine (25/1)
